name: TRITHI Robotics Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Insufficient verified market presence as an active original sensor component brand/manufacturer in India; dropped due to strict verification rules.

name: Vector Technics Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Primarily focused on drone motors, ESCs, and general power distribution components rather than dedicated sensor instrumentation or navigation units.

name: Bharath Components
reason: Lack of verifiable active operations or unique brand infrastructure as an indigenous sensor manufacturer in India; dropped.

name: V3 Novus Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Acts primarily as a defense tech supplier/integrator rather than a dedicated commercial drone sensor manufacturer; failed strict market filter.

name: Ayaan Autonomous Systems Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Primary business is the manufacturing of complete unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV platforms) rather than operating as a dedicated drone sensor manufacturer.

name: DroneStark Technologies (OPC) Private Limited
reason: Primary business is the engineering and manufacture of heavy multi-rotor drone platforms and service robots, not the underlying standalone sensors.

name: Gaxce Sensors (OPC) Private Limited
reason: Gaxce Sensors primarily acts as a distributor, wholesaler, and solution integrator for industrial, environmental, and automotive instrumentation (e.g., VBOX, RECOVIB), not an indigenous manufacturer of drone navigation sensors.

name: 1 Martian Way Industries Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Primary focus is humanoid robotics, agentic AI, software developer tools, and drone racing tracking league software, rather than hardware sensor manufacturing.

name: Drona Aviation Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Primary business is the production of educational programmable nano-drones and DIY STEM kits (Pluto Drones), not acting as a primary manufacturer of standalone drone sensors.

name: Enzo Robotics Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Primary business is the manufacturing of complete drone systems (Enzo-X, Enzo FPV, Thermal Pro) rather than standalone component drone sensors, though it utilizes flight controllers.

name: Airbound Aero Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Primary business is manufacturing autonomous logistics and delivery drone platforms as a whole, rather than specializing primarily in the drone sensor merchant market.
